player_intent: A 2v2 tournament match has a visible six-round regulation limit, resolves timed rounds from authoritative team health, and turns a tied regulation score into a teammate-selected 1v1 sudden death instead of an arbitrary loss or endless draw loop.
acceptance_rule: Each isolated arena plays no more than six regulation rounds and ends early only when its score is mathematically uncatchable; a timeout awards the round to the duo with greater combined server health, an exact health tie consumes a drawn regulation round, and a tied score after round six opens a ten-second vote in which each player can nominate only a member of their own duo. The selected representative from each duo is the only combat-eligible player in sudden death, split or absent votes use the pair captain as deterministic authority, a sudden-death timeout replays the same 1v1, and the first representative eliminated loses the match.

nodes.role: Shows the local duo's two authenticated representative choices, vote counts, and remaining decision time.
Authenticates each vote, forwards server health to the arena rules owner, disables non-selected teammates, and scopes the result to the correct arena.

must_not_change: CharacterBody3D movement, velocity, and collision authority
SOCOM camera and reticle aim authority
server shot, damage, ammunition, and ballistics authority
weapon hand contacts, square-shoulder fire pose, fire recovery, reload, and animation presentation

system_delta.reason: Merge the cap, health timeout rule, authenticated teammate vote, and representative eligibility into the existing arena/session/runtime chain; retain the existing server health, combat, bracket, map, input, and HUD ownership boundaries.

current.system: Forty-second first-to-three arena matches where equal survivor counts create unlimited replayed draws and there is no terminal tied-score or representative-selection phase

candidate.system: Saved six-round regulation rules, authoritative combined-health timeout scoring, arena-scoped teammate vote UI/RPCs, and elimination-only selected-representative sudden death

visual_check: Launch a tournament arena, alternate regulation-round winners to reach 3-3 after six rounds, confirm both members of each duo see only their two named candidates and a ten-second vote, choose representatives, verify the two unselected teammates disappear from combat and cannot fire or receive damage, allow one sudden-death timeout to verify the same representatives replay, then eliminate one representative and confirm the opposing pair advances.
